div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The expert finishes the section's interview and it is written [The expert decides the interview is finished (TR-008)] (DomainExpert)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The expert accepts the offer of review [A grade of 70 or more, zero blocking defects, and a set that checks clean, unless the expert overrides the gate and the override is recorded in section 15] (DomainExpert)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The expert sets the section to final [The expert's decision under TR-002, after an independent grading pass with zero blocking defects, unless the expert overrides the gate and the override is recorded in section 15. No other approval is needed.] (DomainExpert)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The expert changes the section, because a later section shows it is incomplete [The expert's decision under TR-002. The section is graded again before it returns to review.] (DomainExpert)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The expert changes the section after it was set final [The expert's decision under TR-002. If the set was approved, the change records a new version that the earlier approval does not cover (FR-014). A section is never retired, because ids are never reused.] (DomainExpert)
